question: For the first time in the country, which of the following State Governments has implemented a policy for blindness control with the objective of 'Right to Sight'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rajasthan is the first state in India to implement a policy specifically aimed at blindness control.
 
• The policy is named** ‘Right to Sight’**.
 
• The policy includes measures for** prevention, treatment, and rehabilitation of blindness.**
 
• The policy was launched in **January 2023**. The policy aims to reduce the prevalence rate of blindness from** 1.1% in 2020 to 0.3%** through various measures such as** keratoplasty centers** for cornea transplants, eye banks in medical colleges, and public **awareness campaigns**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kerala** known for its high literacy rate and advanced healthcare system; Kerala was the first state in India to achieve **100% primary education through the ‘Athulyam’ literacy program**.
 
• **Maharashtra** was the first state in India to introduce a comprehensive** ‘Right to Services Act’ in 2012,** ensuring timely delivery of government services to citizens.
 
• **Tamil Nadu **was the first state in India to implement the** ‘Midday Meal Scheme’ in 1956**, which aimed to improve nutritional status and school attendance among children.
